meta.name: deepspot-m
meta.description: Generate transcriptome-wide virtual spatial transcriptomics from H&E histology with DeepSpot-M. Use when you need spatial gene expression in log1p-CPM for 224x224 tiles at about 20x, want to query protein-coding genes by symbol instead of a fixed panel, or want to run prediction across a whole slide after tiling with histolab.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 预测组织切片上每个位置的基因表达
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常做病理或肿瘤研究,希望从常规染色切片得到基因表达数据
copy.tagline_en: Predict gene expression at every location from tissue slide images
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you study pathology or tumors and want gene expression from routine tissue slides

howto.what: 把 224x224 的 H&E 组织切片 tile(约 20x)映射成 log1p-CPM 的空间基因表达:每个 tile 按查询的基因给出数值,并与 tile 网格对齐。可用 HGNC 基因名查询约 1.9 万个蛋白编码基因,整张切片可分块批量预测。
howto.when: 当需要 224x224、约 20x 的 tile 的 log1p-CPM 空间基因表达,想按基因名查询蛋白编码基因,或用 histolab 切好 tile 后跑整张切片预测时触发。

say.text: 把这批 tile 跑完整张切片,拼成 tile×基因矩阵并导出 AnnData
say.note: 每个批次用同一份基因列表。

say.text: 换 source=evo2 把同样的 tile 再跑一遍
say.note: 五个嵌入源可选,每次运行选一个。

howto.what_en: Turns 224x224 H&E tiles (~20x) into log1p-CPM spatial gene expression: one value per queried gene per tile, aligned with the tile grid. Query ~19k protein-coding genes by HGNC symbol; whole slides get tiled and predicted in batches.
howto.when_en: Use when you need log1p-CPM spatial expression for 224x224 tiles at ~20x, want to query genes by symbol rather than a fixed panel, or want a whole-slide run after tiling with histolab.

say_en.text: Use DeepSpot-M to predict EPCAM and CD3D expression in this 224x224 tile
say_en.note: Returns log1p-CPM values in gene-list order.

say_en.text: Run these tiles through DeepSpot-M and assemble the slide map as AnnData
say_en.note: Same gene list for every batch.

say_en.text: Rerun the same tiles with source=evo2
say_en.note: Five gene embedding sources; one per run.
